current_prompt.body:
IDENTIFY at least five core entities for the CRM system and LIST their attributes.
IDENTIFY eight business rules or constraints that the CRM must satisfy.
IDENTIFY five edge cases the stakeholder probably hasn't considered.
FORMULATE three clarifying questions needed before implementation.
ENSURE all identified items are based solely on the stakeholder request without adding new requirements.

current_plan.body:
IDENTIFY at least five core entities for the CRM system
FOR each identified entity, LIST its attributes
IDENTIFY eight business rules or constraints that the CRM must satisfy
IDENTIFY five edge cases the stakeholder probably hasn't considered
FORMULATE three clarifying questions needed before implementation
